title: Akool Review 2026: Pricing, Features and Alternatives
summary: Akool review: what it does, plan prices from $12 per seat, the personal-license catch for paid ads, strengths, weaknesses and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## The short answer


- **Akool is a credit-based AI video and image platform** best known for face swap, talking photos, avatars and video translation, plus a model hub that includes Seedance, Kling, Wan, Nano Banana and GPT Image.
- As listed on Akool's pricing page on November 9, 2026: **Starter $12, Pro $21, Pro Max $41.30 and Business $174.30 per seat per month, billed yearly** . Enterprise is custom.
- Starter, Pro and Pro Max list a **personal license** . Only Business and Enterprise list a business or enterprise license, which matters if you run paid ads.
- It suits people-led ad formats: avatars, swaps, translation. It is a toolbox, not an ad workflow.


## What Akool is


Akool is based in Palo Alto, California and sells AI video tooling to creators, marketers and companies. Its homepage groups the product into a set of single-purpose tools and a hub of third-party models.


- **Face Swap, Character Swap, Motion Swap, Head Swap, Hair Swap and Clothing Swap.** Swap a person or element in a photo or video.
- **Talking Photo and Character Studio.** Turn an image into an animated, speaking video, or make videos from an avatar and script without a camera.
- **Streaming Avatar.** An interactive avatar that responds in real time, with session time limits by plan.
- **Video Translation and Video Editor.** Translate and dub video, with a proofreading editor.
- **Shorts Studio.** Turns footage into short-form videos.
- **E-commerce Product Ads and Image Generator.** Product-focused creative and text-to-image.
- **Model Hub.** Access to Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, Google Veo, Sora, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2.0, Flux and Seedream, as listed on its site.
- **OpenAPI and a plugin** for working with Akool from Claude and Codex.


The hub is the biggest recent shift. Akool is no longer only a face-swap and avatar company. It resells access to the same models you could use directly, behind one credit balance.


## Akool pricing


As listed on Akool's pricing page on November 9, 2026. Prices are per seat per month on the yearly toggle. Each plan sells credits, and the page shows selectable credit tiers.


Plan Per seat per month, billed yearly Yearly total Monthly credits (from) Highlights as listed


Free $0 $0 not listed Full-screen watermark, slow processing, 5 GB storage


Starter $12 $144 200 Up to 1080p, no watermark, personal license, limited Seedance 2.0 access, no Seedance 2.5


Pro $21 $252 600 Up to 4K, full Seedance 2.0 access, 6 face swap models, personal license, fast processing


Pro Max $41.30 $495.60 1,200 Up to 8K, Seedance 2.5, API access, workspace collaboration, personal license


Business $174.30 $2,091.60 6,000 Up to 16K, 1 fine-tuned studio avatar, business license, fastest processing


Enterprise Custom Custom Custom SSO, dedicated resources, enterprise license, credits do not expire


Akool's page shows monthly prices of $30 for Pro, $59 for Pro Max and $249 for Business beside the yearly discount. Added team members are billed at the same rate as the plan owner.


What credits buy, per Akool's page: 200 credits equal 100 Nano Banana Pro images or 20 Kling 3.0 videos on Starter. On Pro, 600 credits equal up to 300 Nano Banana Pro images or 60 Kling 3.0 videos. Face swap tools show starting prices of 4 or more credits per run.


Worked example: a team that wants 60 Kling 3.0 test clips a month needs the Pro plan at $21 a seat on the yearly toggle, about 35 cents per clip. Forty more clips would need a bigger credit tier or a credit pack.


## The license question for paid ads


Akool's comparison table lists the license by plan: personal for Starter, Pro and Pro Max, business for Business, enterprise for Enterprise. The word "personal" is the part to read carefully. If a brand pays to run the output as an ad, confirm with Akool in writing what your plan allows. The Business plan at $174.30 a seat is where the page lists a business license.


## Where Akool works for ads


- **Localizing a winning ad.** Video translation takes a proven creative into a new language without a reshoot.
- **Avatar presenters.** Character Studio and Talking Photo produce a spokesperson from a script. See the[AI avatar generator](https://www.sprites.ai/ai-avatar-generator) page for how that format performs in ads.
- **Swaps.** Change the person, outfit or hair in an existing clip to make variants.
- **One credit balance across models.** Test Kling, Seedance and Wan clips without separate accounts.


## Where Akool is weaker for ads


- **Personal licenses below Business.** See above.
- **Credit math.** Cost depends on the tool, model, resolution and length. Plan a test budget in credits before you start.
- **Breadth over depth.** It covers many tools. If you only need clip generation, a specialist such as[PixVerse](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/pixverse-review) lists clean per-second prices.
- **No ad workflow.** It does not write your copy, build campaigns, or report which creative won. You export files and upload them.


## Who should use Akool


You are Akool fits?


A creator or small brand making avatar or talking-photo videos Yes. Starter or Pro covers it.


An ecommerce team localizing winning videos Yes. Video translation is the draw.


An agency making client ads Check the license first. Business is the plan that lists one.


A brand that wants product-ad batches from a URL Look at tools built for that, such as[Topview](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/topview-ai-review) or[MakeUGC](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/makeugc-review) .


A team that wants finished video ads from a brief Try a managed option such as Sprites'[Director](https://www.sprites.ai/director) .

## FAQ


### What is Akool?


Akool is an AI video and image platform with tools for face swap, talking photos, avatars, video translation, an image generator and a model hub that includes Seedance, Kling, Wan and other third-party models. It sells credit-based plans for individuals, teams and enterprises. It also has an API and a plugin for Claude and Codex.


### How much does Akool cost?


As listed on Akool's pricing page on November 9, 2026, Starter is $12 per seat per month billed yearly ($144 a year) with 200 credits a month, Pro is $21 ($252 a year), Pro Max is $41.30 ($495.60 a year) and Business is $174.30 ($2,091.60 a year). Enterprise is custom. A $0 free plan exists with full-screen watermarks.


### Is Akool good for video ads?


It is useful for ad formats built around people: talking avatars, face and character swaps, video translation and photo-to-video. For product-ad batches or a managed ad workflow it is a toolbox rather than a system, so you still brief, generate, review and upload each ad yourself.


### Can I use Akool videos in paid ads?


Akool's pricing page lists a personal license on Starter, Pro and Pro Max, and a business license on the Business plan. If you run paid ads for a company, confirm the license terms for your plan with Akool before you publish.


### Does Akool have a free plan?


Yes. Akool's pricing page lists a Free plan at $0, with full-screen watermarks that are removed on paid plans. Paid plans start with Starter at $12 per seat per month billed yearly.


### What are the best Akool alternatives?


For talking-avatar ads, HeyGen and Arcads are the usual comparisons. For general video generation, PixVerse, Runway and Kling are the main options. For finished video ads from a brief, Sprites' Director add-on is an alternative.
